summary: The publication of the Merer logbooks (IFAO MIFAO 136) states the diary provides NO mention of construction techniques; it documents river transport of Tura limestone but not how the pyramid was raised.
content: Unfortunately, there is no mention of the construction techniques that were employed, which are at present the object of passionate and contradictory debates. ... a team of boatmen, probably comprising some 40 men under the direction of ... Inspector Merer (sḫḏ Mrr), carried out every ten days an average of two or three round-trips ... between the quarries of Tura and the construction site zone.
